description: Land Acquisition - Peliyagoda Gangaboda, Peliyagoda Pattiya, Kelaniya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Extraordinary Gaz. No. 2142/13 dated 24.09.2019, Monaragala D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of 35 specific plots of land being acquired for public purpose. It includes land boundaries, current uses, claimants, and extents, making it clearly a land-related matter that falls under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) classification.
